verbatim_sources: Build more when more creates value
Preserve diversity when diversity creates insight
DO NOT REDUCE THE VISION TO MAKE THE WORK EASIER
MASTER IT. DO NOT MUTILATE IT.
Every pass should make the proposition stronger
If one evidence path fails, search another
TURN EVERY MATERIAL EVENT INTO A PROPOSITION THAT CAN BE PROVEN, ATTACKED, STRENGTHENED, AND USED

source_classes.inference: separate refresh tools without transactionality permit partial renewable-state drift
source_classes.contradiction: none after live transaction; run sequence/frontier remained unchanged during renewable binding refresh

failure_pattern_attacked: Provider and host proof could be refreshed independently, leaving LATEST bound to a mixed old/new pair; near-expiry state also had no CI-visible pre-expiry gate.
concrete_outputs: live provider+host renewal receipt with before/after digests
verification: live forced renewal changed both proof digests and preserved run_sequence=9/frontier exactly
post-renewal validate_deep_progress_latest.py PASS: 23 provider objects, 16 reachable same-repo commits, 5 same-repo blobs, 2 cross-repo proofs
host lifecycle renewed and restored exact state with executable SHA-256 455c2c2438cf423051fa42d1243b7ac42f49a3225a786b61835dfdfa2fba3662

objective_state_delta.before: Provider and host proof leases were independently renewable, so a partial refresh could leave mixed evidence and scheduled execution had no durable near-expiry gate.
objective_state_delta.after: Provider and host proof are refreshed as one validated rollback-safe transaction, LATEST renewable bindings update only after both lanes validate, a before/after renewal receipt is preserved, and Buildkite checks the two-hour renewal horizon before expiry.

unresolved: Atomicity currently covers repository filesystem mutation, not concurrent movement of origin/main between refresh and commit.
The renewal receipt binds evidence digests but does not yet bind the resulting Git commit/blob object identities.
The existing normal Operator checkout remains behind provider main and was intentionally left untouched.
next_executable_frontier: Add optimistic concurrency and commit-aware finalization to proof renewal: refuse renewal when origin/main or the bound recovery tuple moves during the transaction, serialize concurrent renewals, and bind the resulting renewal receipt to the committed Git object identities so a filesystem-valid but uncommitted renewal cannot be mistaken for durable provider state.
